name: Yakuza Kiss
source:
Some call it a neon paradise, but in reality, Cyan City is a hell on earth where the strong prey on the weak. Rays of sunlight seldom breach the thick smog of pollution looming over the city, creating an endless night where the criminal underworld never sleeps.

Jeong Moon had lost everything and everyone. Living in the slum district, she was barely scraping by. Finally pushed to her breaking point, she wanted to leave it all behind. Instead she was pulled even deeper into the belly of the beast and forced to become a member of the Yakuza.

Within their ranks, working to conceal her true identity, she would catch the attention of a dangerous and tormented yakuza leader - Yuki Yamaguchi - a man who had nothing left except his inner demons. To survive in his world, she would have to face her deepest fears and taste her darkest desires - never knowing how the story would end...
translation:
有人称青蓝市为霓虹天堂，但它实际上是一个弱肉强食的人间地狱。笼罩城市的浓重污染烟雾几乎不让阳光穿透，造就了一场无尽的黑夜，犯罪世界永不眠息。

郑文失去了一切，也失去了所有人。她生活在贫民区，勉强维持生计。终于被逼到极限的她想把一切抛在身后，却反而被拖进野兽的腹中，被迫成为黑帮的一员。

她在组织内部努力掩盖真实身份，却引起了危险而饱受折磨的黑帮首领山口由纪的注意。这个男人除了心中的恶魔之外一无所有。为了在他的世界里生存，她必须直面最深的恐惧，品尝最黑暗的欲望，却永远不知道故事将如何结束……
